name: After § 27
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 27 a. Considers that, as long as the Court of Auditors — acting as the external auditor — is unable to issue an unqualified (positive) statement of assurance confirming that the Union budget is properly managed and that the underlying transactions are legal and regular, the Parliament, as a matter of principle, should not support the granting of discharge;
